messages:
sara: heads-up: deploy-bot blocked the final promote for redwood/endpoint:5.7.2 — registry attestation key annotation mismatch across regions. holding the release.

deploy-bot: :warning: publish-guard: attestation-annotation mismatch
expected_kms_annotation=projects/redwood/keys/kms-release-02
observed_kms_annotation (us-ecr)=projects/redwood/keys/kms-release-02
observed_kms_annotation (eu-ecr)=projects/redwood/keys/kms-staging-03
build_id=202603231200 cosign=present

tony: that's odd, eu registry shows the attestation signed by the staging key. could be a mirror that got re-signed during a bad promote.

uma: canary was green but we never promote attestation between regions. maybe a regional mirror rewrite applied a different attestation during cross-account replication.

violet: logs from uploader show a replication event immediately after push: we might have a race where the mirror applied a rewrite plus reattestation with the wrong KMS alias.

sara: options: 1) rollback the promotion and re-run a cross-region publish with correct key; 2) retag in eu-ecr as 5.7.2-eu and attach correct attestation; 3) abort and rebuild. prefer option 2 for minimal blast radius.

tony: +1 for retag in eu and re-attest. keep original 5.7.2 frozen in US region until we confirm. also note this in the release notes and ping security.

uma: I'll perform the manual republish in eu: pull blobs, verify build_id, push redwood/endpoint:5.7.2-eu with canonical manifest, then cosign attest with kms-release-02. Queueing manual_republish now.

deploy-bot: action queued: manual_republish_request by uma for build 202603231200.

uma: pulled blobs, verified build_id matches, canonicalized manifest and pushed 5.7.2-eu -> digest sha256:ff9aaa... uploading cosign attestation with kms-release-02.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: republish completed in eu. attestation_kms=projects/redwood/keys/kms-release-02 registry_manifest=sha256:ff9aaa...

violet: starting provenance lint + smoke on 5.7.2-eu canary. security team looped in.

sara: decision: do not promote original ambiguous 5.7.2 tag across regions. use 5.7.2-eu for eu rollout after QA green. document incident in release audit and create a follow-up to harden cross-region attestation replication.

tony: noted. I'll add a checklist item to prevent automated reattest by mirrors and file a ticket to add an early attestation verification step in the staging pipeline.

uma: canary smoke + provenance lint passed on 5.7.2-eu. requesting gradual rollout at 5%.

deploy-bot: manual rollout requested by uma: route 5% traffic to redwood/endpoint:5.7.2-eu.

sara: monitoring looks normal. closing hold and recording rollout notes: "eu republished as 5.7.2-eu due to region attestation key mismatch; original tag frozen pending audit." :thumbsup:
